_readme: Copy to profile/answers.json (jobagent init does this). A maintained Q&A
bank keeps screening answers consistent across every application. The
tailor agent maps these onto each posting's questions; anything it cannot
answer truthfully from here is flagged NEEDS HUMAN INPUT instead of guessed.

answers.q: Why do you want to work here?
answers.a: Template: 1 sentence on what the company builds that genuinely interests me + 1 sentence connecting it to my platform/ingestion experience. The tailor agent personalizes per company from the posting only.

answers.q: Are you legally authorized to work in the United States?
answers.a: Yes. US citizen, no sponsorship required.

answers.q: Will you now or in the future require sponsorship?

answers.a: Targeting $160k-$185k base depending on total comp structure; flexible for the right role.
Two weeks from accepting an offer.
I'm not relocating at this time; I'm targeting remote roles (US time zones).
